About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

About the ACLU and the Southern Collective

The ACLU dares to create a more perfect union – beyond one person, party, or side. Our mission is to realize this promise of the United States Constitution for all and expand the reach of its guarantees. For over 100 years, the ACLU has been our nation’s guardian of liberty, working in courts, legislatures, and communities to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States. Whether it’s ending mass incarceration, achieving full equality for the LGBTQ+ community, advancing racial justice, establishing new privacy protections for our digital age, or preserving the right to vote or the right to have an abortion, the ACLU takes up the toughest civil liberties and civil rights cases and issues to defend all people from government abuse and overreach. With nearly two million members, activists, and supporters, the ACLU is a nationwide organization that fights tirelessly in all 50 states, Puerto Rico, and Washington, D.C., for the principle that every individual’s rights must be protected equally under the law, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, and record of arrest or conviction.

The Disability Rights Program’s (DRP) mission is to achieve an America free of discrimination against people with disabilities; where people with disabilities are valued, integrated members of society who have full access to education, homes, health care, jobs, families, voting and civic engagement. The ACLU Voting Rights Project was established in 1965 – the same year that the historic Voting Rights Act (VRA) was enacted – and has litigated more than 400 cases since that time. We have three guiding principles: (1) all Americans should be eligible to vote; (2) voting should be free and easy; and (3) all people should count equally. The Project is litigation-focused, with active cases across the country, though it helps support legislative advocacy work and public education. About the Role As a Research Program Manager on the Frontier Assurance team, you will build programs that bring independent expertise into frontier AI safety decisions and make the evidence behind those decisions understandable to the public. We’re looking for people with deep experience in research partnerships and program management with technical and research teams. This role combines partnership management, cross-functional coordination, an understanding of AI safety research, alignment, and evaluations, and strong communication skills. jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description_text:
Position Overview

Alarm.com (ALRM) is a profitable, growing technology company delivering cloud-based software and connected device solutions in the Internet of Things (IoT) space. As we continue to grow and scale globally, our ERP and finance systems are critical to operational efficiency, financial accuracy, scalability, and cross functional alignment across the organization.

We are seeking a Finance Transformation Manager to support key initiatives within Alarm.com’s Finance Transformation program, with a focus on business process improvement, change management, testing, adoption, and ERP transformation execution. This individual contributor role will help support modernization efforts across finance operations, with a primary focus on Order-to-Cash (OTC) transformation initiatives.

jobs.description_text:
About Avride

Avride delivers exceptional, technology-driven transportation experiences. Our fleet supports safe, clean, and efficient mobility solutions that meet the highest standards in the industry. Every vehicle and every team member plays a key role in ensuring quality, safety, and reliability around the clock.

About the Role

The Fleet Associate is responsible for cleaning, sanitizing, charging, and performing light technical inspections on Avride’s autonomous vehicle fleet. This role ensures that every vehicle is connected, updated, and ready for deployment, addressing both cleanliness and basic maintenance needs to support daily fleet performance.

Available Shifts

  • Monday - Saturday, 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM

  • Wash and detail vehicles inside and out, including windows, surfaces, and cargo areas.
  • Ensure vehicles are properly charged and ready for dispatch each morning.
  • Conduct basic mechanical inspections (tire pressure, lights, fluid levels, wipers, etc.).
  • Perform light maintenance such as replacing wiper blades, bulbs, or topping off fluids as trained.
  • Report any mechanical or safety issues promptly to the Operations or Fleet Maintenance team.
  • Move vehicles safely around the lot and in and out of charging bays.

jobs.description_text:
WHAT IS BOX?

Boxは、クラウドコンテンツマネジメント市場におけるリーディングカンパニーです。私達のミッションは、「To power how the world works together」であり、これを実現するために、セキュアで使いやすいコンテンツ管理の基盤をクラウドサービスと提供しています。

Boxはコンテンツ管理にとどまらず、情報共有を効率化するコラボレーション機能や、業務プロセスを効率化するワークフロー機能、電子サイン機能などを提供しています。Boxは、コンテンツを中心とした業務のデジタル化を通して、顧客のデジタルトランスフォーメーションを支えています。

現在、Fortune500の最大手企業を含む、グローバルで10万社以上の企業に製品を提供しています。Boxは、クラウドコンテンツ・マネジメント市場のリーダーとして、今後も革新的なサービスを通して市場を拡大していきます。

 

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU 

Box Consulting Teamのミッションは 「クラウド上での文書管理の新しい姿にお客様を“導く”」ことです。文書管理やコンテンツを中心とした業務のデジタル化のゴールを示し、変革を実現するためのロードマップを定義し、変革の実現を強力に支援します。

Box Consulting Teamでは、テクノロジーとコンサルティングスキルを生かして、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションを実現し、一緒にチームのミッションの実現の一翼を担って頂ける導入コンサルタントを募集しています。

コンテンツは企業の全ての業務で使われていると言っても過言では無く、Boxはあらゆる業務を変革するポテンシャルがあります。広範囲に変革をもたらすが故に、適切なゴール設定と設計、利用定着化に向けた戦略が必要です。

このポジションは、新規および既存のお客様がBoxプラットフォームを導入する際に、お客様の目線に立ち、お客様のクラウドでのコンテンツ管理の理想像を描き、お客様の変革を実現することをお任せします。

導入コンサルタントは、お客様のステークホルダーと密に連携しながらプロジェクトの進捗を管理し、高い専門性を持ってお客様の業務及び技術に関してプロフェッショナルなアドバイスを提供します。初期導入プロジェクトの開始から完了、その後の継続的な利用定着化活動、利用拡大をプロジェクト単位で担います。構想策定からビジネス要件とユースケースの把握、スコープをコントロールしながら成果物の実行に向けたプロジェクトマネジメントを担当頂きます。

導入コンサルタントは、複数のお客様向けのプロジェクトを同時進行で管理し、Boxの他の組織のメンバーと協働しプロジェクトを成功に導きます。

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • プロジェクト計画やプロジェクトリソースの管理を含む、新規Box顧客の実装のリードする
  • お客様毎に、構想策定、初期導入支援、利用定着化のための計画を確実に実行する
  • プロジェクトの進捗管理、課題・リスク管理、リソース管理を適切に行い、状況を関係者に報告する
  • お客様のユー

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager
jobs.description_text:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box(NYSE: BOX)はインテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では約19,000社および日経225の76%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。
Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアに拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。

Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。

 

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU 

日本におけるBoxのビジネスは、100%パートナーを通じて展開されています。そのため、パートナーとの協業を広げ、より多くのお客様へBoxを届けていくことが、Box Japanの成長に直結します。

このポジションでは、複数の販売パートナーを担当し、パートナーの皆さまと一緒にBoxビジネスを成長させていただきます。

本社・主管部門との関係構築だけではなく、営業部門や地域拠点など、実際にお客様と接する営業担当者との接点を広げることも重要な役割です。

パートナーを訪問し、営業担当者との関係をつくり、案件創出、勉強会、セミナー、共同営業などを通じて、Boxを販売いただける機会を増やしていきます。

社内の営業、Marketing、SE、Customer Successなどとも連携しながら、自分自身でアイデアを出し、行動し、パートナーと一緒にビジネスを大きくしていくことを楽しめる方を求めています。

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • 複数の販売パートナーを担当し、Partner Business Planや営業施策を策定・実行する

  • パートナーの主管部門だけでなく、営業部門、地域拠点などとの関係を構築する

  • パートナーの営業担当者との接点を増やし、新規案件やPipelineの創出につなげる

  • パートナー向け勉強会、トレーニング、セミナー、共同営業施策などを企画・実行する

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern
jobs.description_text:
Empowered to live. Inspired to work.
Compeer Financial is a member-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together team members with a variety of backgrounds and experiences to help provide financial services to support agriculture and rural communities. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally.

How we support you:

  • Hybrid model – up to 50% work from home
  • Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months
  • Up to 9% towards 401k (3% fixed Compeer contribution plus up to 6% match)
  • Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life & AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability, wellness program & EAP
  • Vacation, sick leave, holidays/floating holidays, parental leave, and volunteer paid time off
  • Learning and development programs
  • Mentorship programs
  • Cross-functional committee opportunities (i.e. Inclusion Council, emerging professional groups, etc.)
  • Professional membership/certification reimbursement and more!

Casual/seasonal & intern team members are not eligible for benefits except for state-mandated programs.

Correlation One is the largest provider of AI and data workforce development programs globally, having trained over 500,000 professionals across 11 countries. As the largest training provider for Amazon Career Choice, and a growing partner to state governments building registered apprenticeship programs, Correlation One sits at the intersection of employer talent needs and scalable workforce training.

We work with Fortune 500 enterprises, federal and state government agencies, and leading employers to close skills gaps in AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, and operations leadership. Our programs produce job-ready graduates who are prepared to contribute from day one.

Your impact 

The Operations Analyst (OA) collaborates with our Program Managers and assists in the management of Correlation One’s live, online training programs that can serve hundreds of students at a time. The OA works with the Business Operations and Curriculum teams, contracted instructors and teaching assistants to complete ad hoc projects to uncover insights about our data and/or digital skills training programs.

The ideal candidate is an excellent project manager and is able to execute simultaneous competing deadlines and tasks involving multiple stakeholders. jobs.title: Loading Dock Attendant (M-F 7am-4pm)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

This role is crucial for ensuring the smooth operation of residential moves and maintaining the overall upkeep of our property. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating the arrival and departure of moving trucks, scheduling and monitoring on-site movers, and protecting property during deliveries and moves. Additional responsibilities include managing bulk material pickups, conducting daily residential garage inspections, and ensuring building security through routine FOB checks. The Loading Dock Attendant will also liaise with vendors for routine cleaning schedules, report incidents to the property manager, and submit maintenance tickets for timely resolution. Flexibility to assist with various tasks as assigned by the property manager and the engineering & operations team is essential. 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Coordinate the arrival and departure of moving trucks 
  • Coordinate residential move in and move outs, to include scheduling and monitoring on site movers
  • Protect doors and floors during deliveries and moves
  • Coordinate pickups and removal of bulk material items from loading dock and trash room areas
  • Report incidents or accidents to property manager as needed 
  • Complete daily Residential garage inspections and provide inspection report to manager
  • Manage routine cleaning schedules by vendor

jobs.title: Invoice Reconciliations Manager (Media)
jobs.description_text:
Join Critical Mass as our Invoice Reconciliations Manager (Media), with a focus on media billing and operational oversight. In this role, you will lead and oversee key media investment processes, ensuring accurate and timely billing, effective campaign management, and strong financial controls across client accounts. You will partner closely with investment, account, finance and operations teams to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure campaign and billing activities are delivered accurately and efficiently. If you have strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, experience in media investment or billing, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we invite you to apply and become a key part of our team.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in alignment with Eastern Time (ET).

You Will

  • Own the coordination of campaign timelines and provide day-to-day operational support to the investment team throughout campaign activation, including actualization, billing validation and vendor invoice reconciliation.
  • Manage campaign setup, buy entry and ongoing maintenance across relevant media systems, ensuring all activity aligns with client-approved budgets, Media Authorization Forms (MAFs) and agreed buying parameters.
  • Review campaign and billing inputs for accuracy, identify discrepancies and work proactively with internal team
